girl: A girl is a female child or teenager; someone who is not a woman yet.
Many girls like to play with dolls.
A female person of any age (even a woman).
The girls are going out tonight, do you want to come?
girlfriend: A girlfriend is a girl or young woman who is in a romantic relationship with another person.
Jeremy had been having trouble with his girlfriend.
A girlfriend can be any friend who is female.
give: If you give something to someone else, you had the thing and you let the other person have it. Maybe you use your hands to put the thing in the other person's hands. Usually after that, the thing is the other person's thing.
Give me that book, please; I want to read it.
If you give a speech, you talk to a group of people.
given: Given x means if x is true, happened, exists, etc.
Given our current problems, I don't think we can spend any more.
Given that-clause means in consideration of the fact that-clause.
Given that they are inexperienced, they've done a good job.
If someone is given to doing something, they do it regularly.
My father's given to making long speeches about when he was a boy.
If someone is given to something, they wear, use, or do it often.
When she got older, she was given to elegant clothes and long speeches.
A given is something that you accept as true.
We need to make a decision about where we will live after this, but selling this house is a given.
giant: A giant is a very big man or woman, often in fairy tales.
Jack climbed the beanstalk and found a land ruled by a giant.
If a thing is giant, it is very big.
He bought a giant doll at the fair.
gibberish: ; Gibberish is a language that is not understandable, because it has no meaning or is too complicated or technical.
Extraterrestrials in bad science-fiction often speak gibberish to make you understand that they are extraterrestrials.
gibber: To gibber is to speak in a way you that cannot be understood, especially when using unknown words or known words that have no meaning put together.
This magician gibbers when he does his tricks, because he wants to appear more mysterious.
gift: A gift is something given to another person voluntarily.
I didn't receive many gifts this Christmas.
A special talent or natural ability.
She has a gift for singing.
A gift is given to someone as a present.
I received a gift from my parents as my Christmas present.
girth: The girth of an object is the distance measured around it.
Year after year, the expanding girth of the trees became more and more obvious.
giraffe: The giraffe is the tallest land animal in the world. It is from Africa and has a very long neck.
The family went to see the giraffe in the zoo.
giggle: When you giggle, you laugh softly.
Boys often laugh out loud and girls often giggle quietly.
gill: A gill is the breathing organ for animals that live in the sea. It helps them breathe oxygen inside of water.
If I had a gill, then I could breathe underwater.
If you gill a fish, you remove the gills from it.
gigabyte: My new computer has 100 gigabytes of memory and a 200 gigabyte hard drive.
gigantic: Something that, when it is described, is even bigger than the word "large". Something that is very, very large.
When it comes to canyon formations, the Grand Canyon is gigantic.
girlish: If someone is girlish, they act, look, or sound like a young girl.
Her girlish voice had deepened with age.
ginger: Ginger is a strongly flavored root used in cooking.
Ginger is used to make gingerbread and ginger beer.
A ginger is someone with reddish brown hair.
gizmo: A gizmo is a vague name for any small electronic device.
gimme: A gimme is something that is easy to get.
In golf, a gimme is a shot when the ball is very, very close to the hole.
gigaton: A gigaton is a unit that is used to determine how strong an explosion made by a bomb is.
girder: A girder is a large iron or steel beam that is used to build bridges and frame large buildings.
gin: Gin is an alcoholic drink that is made from grain or malt.
gifted: If a person is gifted, he or she has special or talents.
gingerbread: A gingerbread is a type of cake whose main flavoring is ginger.
gilt: A gilt is a thin layer of gold.
A gilt is a security issued by the .
If something is gilt, it is covered with gold or has a golden color.
gild: If you gild something, you cover it with a thin layer of gold.
gilled: If something is gilled, it has gills.
giver: A giver is someone who gives something to another person or people.
Santa Claus is a giver of gifts.
girly: Something that is girly is for girls, or like a girl.
That flowery shirt is so girly!
giddy: If you feel giddy, you have a spinning sensation in the head causing you to have a perception of being unsteady and being about to fall.
girlishness: The girlishness of someone is how girlish that person is.
giantess: A giantess is a female giant.
gig: A gig is a live performance by a musician or group playing popular or jazz music.
If a person gigs, they play at a gig.
